DAG: wow_pvp_full_pipeline
Schedule: 0 6 * * * (daily 06:00)

2) extract_leaderboard_to_landing
3) load_leaderboard_raw_to_db

5) extract_chinfo_to_landing
6) load_chinfo_raw_to_db
